options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: URL to API endpint (without trailing slash). Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_ENDPOINT).

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the Vultr API. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_KEY).

options.name: api_results_per_page
options.description: When receiving large numbers of resources, specify how many results should be returned per call to API. This does not determine how many results are returned; all resources are returned according to other filters. Vultr API maximum is 500. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_RESULTS_PER_PAGE).

options.name: api_retries
options.description: Amount of retries in case of the Vultr API retuns an HTTP error code, such as - 429 Too Many Requests - 500 Internal Server Error - 504 Gateway Time-out Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_RETRIES).

options.name: api_retry_max_delay
options.description: Retry backoff delay in seconds is exponential up to this max. value, in seconds. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_RETRY_MAX_DELAY).

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout to Vultr API. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_TIMEOUT).

options.name: ip_block
options.description: The subnet of the VPC. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: ip_type
options.description: Type of the IP version. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: prefix_length
options.description: The number of bits for the netmask in CIDR notation, e.g. 24. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: region
options.description: Region the VPC will be related to. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate SSL certs of the Vultr API.
